snippet.title: DBP73: Narcoleptic Strata - Showcase
snippet.description:
DBP73: Narcoleptic Strata is a fourteen-map Doom II episode for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz. The theme was luminescent and dreamy alien landscapes with mushrooms. It is the 73rd installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series and released on June 1st, 2025.

You can get the project at:
https://doomer.boards.net/thread/4010/narcoleptic-strata
